review.finding: The abort message tells the user to run `git mv shipwright_events.d .shipwright/events/drops`. When .shipwright/events/drops already exists (main checkout after git pull) git mv nests the folder INSIDE it, so readers (glob *.jsonl directly in the folder) never see the events; with only untracked files git mv fails; the tool path in the message is monorepo-relative.
review.suggestion: Lead with the tool (per-file, never nests, handles untracked files) with a plugin-root path; keep git mv only with the caveat 'only when the new folder does not exist yet'; add a test that runs the tool against a tree where the new folder already exists.

review.finding: `if drops_folder_ignored(...): return False` runs BEFORE the HEAD-blob loop, so a drop that IS committed in HEAD fails whenever the folder's ignore rule matches (tracked files inside an ignored folder, e.g. git mv into a not-yet-healed repo, or force-added files). In the other ignored cases the loop already falls through to the final return False.
review.suggestion: Delete the early return; the ignored, uncommitted case still fails through the final return False and iterate_checks adds the hint. Add a test with a drop committed in HEAD inside an ignored folder expecting True.

review.finding: The 'event folder is git-ignored' hint is appended to every committed-is-False result, including legacy-layout failures.
review.suggestion: Add the hint only when the event was found in a drop file / layout is drops.

review.finding: _effective treats any check-ignore rc other than 1 as not effective; a git error (rc 128) silently drops all folder rules, contradicting its own keep-the-lines policy.
review.suggestion: Return True (keep) if any rc is not in (0, 1); False only if some rc is 0.

review.finding: _plan moves OS junk too (Thumbs.db etc land in the drops folder and trip the integrity check); an identical empty .keep in both places triggers the 'exists in both places' refusal.
review.suggestion: Skip OS_JUNK_NAMES (delete them when emptying the old folder); treat a byte-identical collision as already moved.

review.finding: Error handling gaps: shutil.move/mkdir raise uncaught OSError (traceback, partial move); missing git binary raises FileNotFoundError not exit 2; never-overwrites holds only at plan time; docstring exit codes omit migrated_incomplete.
review.suggestion: Wrap the move loop in try/except returning move_failed with moved; re-check exists() before each untracked move; update the docstring.

review.finding: A side effect hidden in a conditional expression (mkdir inside `if ... is None else None`).
Three integrity tests assert loose code sets; the rename test passes only through an incidental foreign_key on the add.
review.suggestion: Assert the exact entry flagged (old path bad_path with 'moved to') and use own_keys=('run-a',).

review.finding: Name copies: OS_JUNK_NAMES defined twice, routing.real_dir duplicates real_event_dir, adopt events_layout_key.py hardcodes the folder; the guard test covers only some of them.
review.suggestion: Extend the guard test to the junk set and the adopt literal.
